newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Orlando Wyndham reserves position on bid.
newsitem.headline: Orlando Wyndham reserves position on bid.

text.p: Australian winemaker Orlando Wyndham said on Sunday it was disappointed it had not been told in advance by Simeon Wines Ltd of its takeover bid for Australian Vintage Ltd (Austvin).
Orlando Wyndham, owned by the French Pernod Ricard group and Simeon's largest shareholder, said it was concerned about potential dilution of its stake.
The winemaker, which held 37 percent of Simeon in August last year, said it was seeking more information about the offer and would reserve its position on the bid.
Austvin on Wednesday advised its shareholders not to sell ahead of the completion of an independent expert's report.
Simeon, which was floated in 1994, has said a successful merger would create Australia's fourth largest winemaker by volume.
It has offered four of its shares plus A$3.60 cash for every five Austvin shares, valuing Austvin at about A$111 million.
